column12: testRejectsDeclaredDecompressedSizeOverLimit (TestCompressedRTF) lowers the ceiling to 4 and decompresses an UNCOMPRESSED header that declares 5 bytes; here the 5 bytes are present as well, so only the ceiling is exceeded, and Bodu documents that an uncompressed (MELA) payload longer than MaxDecompressedRtfBytes throws OutlookMsgFormatException (docs/guides/outlook/reader-options-and-limits.md:38)

column4: CompressedRTF trusted the declared size: a ceiling on it now rejects larger payloads, and output beyond it (plus 7 bytes of padding) is rejected (bb22350be5)
column12: testRejectsCompressedRtfExpansionBeyondDeclaredPadding (TestCompressedRTF) expects a RecordFormatException for this body (control byte 0xFF, eight references 00 00, RAWSIZE 1), which expands to 16 bytes; Bodu bounds the output by the declared size instead and stops there (Bodu.Formats.Outlook/shared/CompressedRtf.cs:42-46, the decoder's XML documentation), so the first reference copies only the first byte of the 207-byte prologue, {. The CRC is the correct one (the upstream test leaves it 0). MS-OXRTFCP 2.2.3.2 would treat this input as corrupt, since it ends without an end reference
